doc: Gil's hand-keyed clips (art/wardens/gil/gil.glb, tools/art1/gil_clips.py) and which game state plays which (scripts/heroes/warden_clips.gd). The swordfish is skinned to hand.R in the .glb: the procedural swordfish (HeroArmsGil) hides and the Gun node is only the invisible aim and FX reference, kept on the blade empties (anchor_blade_root on hand.R, weapon_muzzle at the bill tip) so thrusts, potions and the spout leave the weapon you see. The Fencer thrusts take the whole body standing; while the lunge slides him, the legs keep the run under them (upper: moving).
